comparison.candidate_input: Image + frozen descriptions generated from retrieved evidence

report_context.scope_summary: It evaluated 11 diagnosis labels in four clinical differentials: lung, colon, infectious esophagitis, and skin cancer.
report_context.sample_note: The exact selected image bytes are stored in the repository, and every SHA-256 checksum is verified before inference.
report_context.source_note: LC25000 images use fixed evenly spaced rows from the public dataset; infectious-esophagitis and skin-cancer images are published educational figures.
coverage_gaps: This diagnosis suite has only one or two examples for several non-LC25000 labels.
It does not yet cover breast, prostate, kidney, liver, brain, bone, gynecologic, or hematolymphoid diagnoses.
The broad-organ replacement benchmark is pending separate PathMMU dataset approval.
next_steps: Add an expert-reviewed PathMMU subset after the Hugging Face account is approved for that gated dataset.
Use patient-independent disease datasets with enough cases for a held-out split in every label.
Keep report-writing evaluation separate from image classification accuracy.

lung histopathology.benign lung tissue: benign lung tissue with preserved alveolar architecture, thin alveolar walls, absence of cellular atypia
lung histopathology.lung adenocarcinoma: lung adenocarcinoma with malignant glandular structures, lepidic growth patterns, mucin production
lung histopathology.lung squamous cell carcinoma: lung squamous cell carcinoma with keratin pearls, intercellular bridges, eosinophilic cytoplasm

colon histopathology.benign colonic tissue: benign colonic tissue with orderly crypt architecture, mature goblet cells
colon histopathology.colorectal adenocarcinoma: colorectal adenocarcinoma with malignant glands, desmoplastic stroma, dirty necrosis

infectious esophagitis.Candida esophagitis: Candida esophagitis with fungal hyphae and pseudohyphae, spores invading squamous epithelium, neutrophilic inflammation
infectious esophagitis.herpes simplex virus esophagitis: herpes simplex virus esophagitis with multinucleated giant squamous cells, nuclear molding, ground-glass intranuclear inclusions, chromatin margination
infectious esophagitis.cytomegalovirus esophagitis: cytomegalovirus esophagitis with cytomegaly in endothelial or stromal cells, basophilic intranuclear inclusions with clear halo, owl-eye appearance

skin cancer histopathology.basal cell carcinoma: basal cell carcinoma with basophilic tumor islands, peripheral nuclear palisading, stromal retraction, loose mucinous stroma
skin cancer histopathology.cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma: cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma with pleomorphic keratinocytes, prominent nucleoli, increased mitoses, invasive epidermal islands
skin cancer histopathology.melanoma: melanoma with irregular nests of melanocytes, single pleomorphic pigmented cells, epidermal and dermal distribution
